topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: I took the case, stepped through the door of faded glory and family secrets. The house, a relic of better days, stood silent, swallowing the echoes of laughter and the thud of old grievances. The siblings, eyeing each other with the wary respect of alley cats, each thought the other a thief. One wanted to sell, the other to keep. To me, it was clear: this place held more than just memories. Behind every smile, a calculation. Behind every sigh, a story of loss. I didn’t need to hear their grandmother’s whispers to know the walls were thick with unsaid words. I took the job, but as I sifted through the dusty relics, I couldn’t shake the thought that maybe, just maybe, I’d be the one to unravel the last threads of their family.
